message.content: {"summary":"Your report presents a coherent, well-structured mission concept that covers all required elements with STK evidence and a persuasive rationale. To reach the next level, strengthen the design with quantitative support: justify the launch and RAAN choices, add hand calculations and a link budget, complete the EOL analysis, and tighten figure labelling and referencing.","criteria":{"C1":"Your Introduction clearly states the mission purpose, the need for coral-reef monitoring, the single-spacecraft justification and the users, with literature support. This is Accomplished work. To secure the top of this band, sharpen the operator versus customer distinction and ensure every claim carries a specific reference.","C2":"All major design elements are covered with STK screenshots and access data, but the design sits at Adequate. The Vega E choice is speculative and rests on a Wikipedia timeline; the RAAN justification is weak; there is no link budget or hand calculation for the sun-synchronous inclination; the EOL paragraph is truncated with no drag-sail sizing or deorbit estimate; and the swath/altitude trade-off is left unresolved. To reach Accomplished, resolve these with quantitative evidence and defensible sources.","C3":"Your Conclusion restates the design and acknowledges launch risk, which is Adequate. To reach Accomplished, synthesise the evidence quantitatively and give a specific, justified recommendation rather than a section-by-section summary.","C4":"Structure and headings are clear, but figures lack numbered captions, references are bare URLs including a Wikipedia source, and there are typos and a broken reference. To reach Accomplished, add numbered captions, use consistent professional referencing, and proofread for spelling and grammar."},"next_steps":["Replace the Vega E/Wikipedia launch justification with a currently operational vehicle and a cited, defensible rationale; justify the RAAN choice independently of launch site.","Add hand calculations for the sun-synchronous inclination and a link budget/data-rate analysis supporting the contact duration, and resolve the swath/altitude trade-off with sensor parameters.","Complete the EOL section with drag-sail sizing and a deorbit time estimate, and fix figure captions and referencing (numbered captions, no bare URLs or Wikipedia)."]}
